results.content: Brand New Day swept the box office at the jump with a $360 million domestic debut. It has now grossed $407 million in the US after six days of screening, nudging ahead of The Odyssey ($405 million). Brand New Day now ranks 54th on the all-time list of top domestic grossers, outpacing previous blockbusters, including James Cameron's billion-dollar epic. [...] Brand New Day was reportedly in development as early as 2024, with Destin Daniel Cretton tagged as the frontrunner to direct. Things ramped up in 2025 after Cretton and Tom Holland signed on to the project, and both announced the film was officially in the works at CinemaCon later that year.
